method.consumer: sequential HTTP API consumer; no browser or UI evidence
method.cold: One first application request per endpoint/scenario after seed; PG/OS caches NOT flushed. No cold percentiles.
method.percentiles: nearest rank; n=50 p99 equals maximum, not a stable tail estimate
method.bytes: UTF-8 uncompressed HTTP response body only; excludes headers/TCP/TLS
method.seededHistory: SQL bulk synthetic completed records, bypassing write ingress; HTTP ingress limits checked separately
method.agentCapacity: Not measured; 1/16/128 are stored task counts, never executing agents

candidateBacklog.sql:
SELECT tl.task_id,tl.cursor,t.submission->>'title',tl.entry
  FROM flow.tasks t
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT task_cursor FROM flow.workspace_feed WHERE task_id=t.id ORDER BY task_cursor DESC LIMIT 1
  ) projected ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT task_id,cursor,entry FROM flow.timeline
    WHERE task_id=t.id AND cursor>projected.task_cursor ORDER BY cursor LIMIT $1
  ) tl ON true
  ORDER BY t.created_at,t.id,tl.cursor LIMIT $1
candidateBacklog.limitation: Synthetic contiguous per-task histories only; production late-commit and 201-task regressions still required before a product fix

INSERT INTO flow.workspace_feed(task_id,task_cursor,task_title,entry)
      SELECT t.id,0,t.submission->>'title',jsonb_build_object(
        'id','accepted:'||t.id,'cursor',0,'createdAt',to_char(t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
        'kind','text','text','Task accepted.')
      FROM flow.tasks t LEFT JOIN flow.workspace_feed f ON f.task_id=t.id AND f.task_cursor=0
      WHERE f.ordinal IS NULL ORDER BY t.created_at,t.id LIMIT $1
